name: Captain Fauvette

abilities.name: Ice Arrow
abilities.description: Basic ranged attack dealing minor frost damage.

abilities.name: Burdening Eye
abilities.description: Captain Fauvette summons a Burdening Eye that moves toward a player.

abilities.name: Burden
abilities.description: If the Burdening Eye touches the player, it explodes, dealing minor magic damage and snaring in an area.

abilities.name: Summon Allies
abilities.description: Captain Fauvette periodically summons a Ghost Strongarm and a Ghost Swashbuckler to fight for her.

abilities.name: Summon Totem
abilities.description: Captain Fauvette periodically summons her Totem, deals fast ticks of direct minor poison damage around it. It also continuously casts areas that travel in a straight line in four directions which root targets hit for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Run Away!
abilities.description: When too close to her, Captain Fauvette backs up to put some distance between her target and herself.

dialogue.speaker: Vanisande Maul
dialogue.line: There's lingering doubt about this book. Regrets are a lost soul's anchor.
